        Local unprivileged user can trigger an assert in systemd when a Delegate=yes and User=<unset> unit exists and is running
      

    

    

        

          
  Moderate

Package

    

      systemd    
  

  

      
Affected versions

      
>= 258
  

  

      
Patched versions

      
260
  

  

    

  

  
Description

  

    
Impact

systemd (as PID 1) hits an assert and freezes execution if a system unit with Delegate=yes (not default) and no User= (default) is present and running on a system, when an unprivileged IPC API call is made:

busctl call org.freedesktop.systemd1 /org/freedesktop/systemd1/unit/foo_2eservice org.freedesktop.systemd1.Service AttachProcesses "sau" "" 1 0

Versions v258 and v259 are affected. Older versions are not affected.

Patches

v260 05f5156

v259.2 36afb08

v258.5 fd41e25

Workarounds

Stop and disable any system unit with Delegate=yes (not default) and no User= (default)

References

Originally reported on yeswehack.com as #YWH-PGM9780-89
